record.question: The ideal time for clamping the umbilical cord in an uncomplicated birth is:
options: Delayed for at least 1–3 minutes after birth
record.explanation: Answer C: Delayed for at least 1–3 minutes after birth. For a vigorous newborn after uncomplicated birth, delayed cord clamping for at least 30–60 seconds is recommended; WHO commonly recommends 1–3 minutes. Source/context note: Timing may be modified for maternal/newborn emergencies or specific resuscitation needs. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241508209. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
